        break

# Extract JSON from the code block

cancel_policy = json.loads(cancel_json)

# Read existing report

    existing = f.read()

# Build cancellation section
lines = [
    "",
    "---",
    "",
    "## Travel Cancellation Policy",
    "",
    "The following cancellation policy applies to all travel bookings managed by Meridian Analytics.",
    "Rules vary by cabin class and route type (domestic vs. international).",
    "",
    "### Free Cancellation Window",
    "",
    "- " + rules["free_cancellation_window"],
    "",
    "### Cancellation Fees by Cabin Class",
    "",
    "| Cabin Class | Route Type | Fee |",
    "|---|---|---|",
    "| Basic Economy | All | " + rules["basic_economy"] + " |",
    "| Economy | Domestic | " + rules["economy_domestic"] + " |",
    "| Economy | International | " + rules["economy_international"] + " |",
    "| Business | Domestic | " + rules["business_domestic"] + " |",
    "| Business | International | " + rules["business_international"] + " |",
    "| First | All | " + rules["first"] + " |",
    "",
    "### Additional Rules",
    "",
    "- **Travel Insurance:** " + rules["insurance"],

    "",

    "",
]
cancellation_section = "\\n".join(lines)

# Combine
full_report = existing.rstrip() + "\\n" + cancellation_section

# Write
with open("workspace/docs/q3_report.md", "w") as f:
    f.write(full_report)

print("SUCCESS")
print("Rules extracted:")
for k, v in rules.items():
    print("  " + k + ": " + v)
print("Full report length: " + str(len(full_report)))
'''
